rules.title: Allow/Disallow before any User-agent
rules.fix: Move the line under a User-agent group. RFC 9309 parsers ignore rules that are not inside a group.

rules.title: Retired crawler token
rules.fix: Replace with the token the vendor publishes today.

rules.title: Token no published crawler uses
rules.fix: Use the exact published token; robots.txt matching is on the token, so a near-miss reserves nothing.

rules.title: No AI training crawler is reserved against
rules.fix: Add a group per training crawler with Disallow: / so the reservation is machine-readable.

rules.title: Training crawlers left unreserved
rules.fix: Add a group with Disallow: / for each missing token.

rules.title: Training crawler explicitly allowed
rules.fix: An empty Disallow: or Allow: / grants full access. Use Disallow: / to reserve.

rules.title: Its own group cancels the * group
rules.fix: A crawler obeys only its most specific group; repeat the * group paths inside it.

rules.title: Noindex in robots.txt
rules.fix: Google stopped honouring Noindex in robots.txt on 2019-09-01. Use a meta robots tag or X-Robots-Tag header.

rules.title: Crawl-delay is not in RFC 9309
rules.fix: Googlebot and GPTBot ignore it. Rate-limit at the server or CDN instead.

rules.title: Path does not start with /
rules.fix: Paths are matched from the site root; write /path, not path.

rules.title: Sitemap is not an absolute URL
rules.fix: Sitemap: takes a full https:// URL, not a relative path.

rules.title: Same token in two groups
rules.fix: Merge the groups; which one wins is parser-dependent.

rules.title: Line is not a robots.txt directive
rules.fix: Parsers drop the line silently. Use User-agent, Allow, Disallow or Sitemap, or prefix it with #.

rules.title: No pointer to a TDMRep signal
rules.fix: robots.txt is a crawler instruction. Add /.well-known/tdmrep.json and reference it in a comment so the reservation is machine-readable in the TDMRep sense.

rules.title: User-triggered fetcher blocked
rules.fix: This token fetches a page because a person asked for it. Blocking it drops the citation and the referral without stopping training.

trainers.CCBot: Common Crawl, the corpus most model builders start from

agents.ChatGPT-User: fetches a page when a person asks ChatGPT about it
agents.OAI-SearchBot: builds the ChatGPT search index that links back to you
agents.Claude-User: fetches a page when a person asks Claude about it
agents.Claude-SearchBot: builds the search index Claude cites from
agents.Perplexity-User: fetches a page a person asked Perplexity about
